prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1157; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Rear bumper cover cracked across the center with the left tail lamp assembly broken, and the trunk lid edge shows a crease consistent with the impact. The lower panel behind the bumper also shows scuffing that may or may not have resulted from this collision, so the question of whether all of it came from this impact remains open until the teardown is complete. Labor hours listed for panel replacement, refinishing and reassembly fit the damage observed. The billing records reviewed show no repeated charges for the same operation. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from the file. Plan: replace the bumper cover and tail lamp, straighten and refinish the trunk edge, and reassess the lower panel once it is exposed.
